title: Account Management Note: The Current Month's Late Charge in a Microsoft 365 Payment Arrangement
content:
In a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) payment arrangement, a late charge posted on the subscription less than one whole month before the arrangement is handled according to the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services service level:

- **Left out of the arrangement.** The client's active ClearPath tier has a dedicated account manager. The late charge is left out of the arrangement and stays on the invoice outside it. It is neither spread nor collected with the first instalment. A balance no greater than that late charge leaves nothing to arrange, so no arrangement is made.
- **Due up front.** No active ClearPath tier with a dedicated account manager is held. The late charge is due up front in full with the first instalment. It is set aside from the arrangement balance and not spread.
- **No late charge in that month.** Nothing is set aside for it.

**Records read.** The late charge and its posting date are read from the subscription's billing ledger. Whether a dedicated account manager is held is read from whether the client's active ClearPath Managed IT Services tier assigns a named client success manager.

## Judgement table

| Late charge posted less than one whole month before the arrangement | Active ClearPath tier with a dedicated account manager | Treatment of that late charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | left out of the arrangement; stays on the invoice. With a balance no greater than that late charge, no arrangement is made. |
| yes | no, or no active ClearPath agreement | due up front in full with the first instalment |
| no | any | nothing set aside |

## Hypothetical illustration (arrangement made on 18 May)

A late charge of 45.00 USD was posted on 1 May, which is less than one whole month before the arrangement.

- With an active ClearPath tier that has a dedicated account manager, the 45.00 stays on the invoice. It is not part of what the arrangement spreads or collects.
- Without such a tier, the 45.00 is paid in full with the first instalment.

A late charge posted on 1 April is a whole month or more before 18 May. It is not handled under this note.
